calls.title: Jun 01, 07:59 AM
calls.summary: Unisport is evaluating whether to self-host GrowthBook or adopt its cloud-hosted enterprise plan, considering several factors such as workload, cost, and compliance with internal data privacy policies. Anton clarified that no personal identifiable information (PII) would be involved in their A/B tests, allowing for the use of anonymous IDs. While self-hosting adds operational overhead, it is preferred by some EU customers for internal security reasons. Scott provided pricing insights, noting that Unisport anticipates running about five experiments monthly, with a detailed quote on pricing expected. The integration compatibility with Unisport’s tech stack, specifically Next.js and various data warehouses like BigQuery and Snowflake, was highlighted as crucial for implementation. The meeting also outlined a plan for a technical demo and proof of concept to address potential implementation challenges.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, Enterprise plan, Self-hosted, Data warehouse, Experimentation platform
